name: Three Rules of Life
source:
A high school senior struggling with his mother suddenly leaving the family is forced to repeat the year. As he tries to make sense of his life, he finds himself caught up in the increasingly complex affairs of those around him.

This is a game about friendship, love, and, above all, growing up. It contains not only adult material, but adult themes.

Comedy and reflection, romance and drama, love and regret are woven throughout a story driven by characters with real personalities and motivation.

Your choices will affect relationships with these characters and the paths they take. Small decisions, accrued over time, will impact how your story plays out.

Will you help those around you find what they're looking for and, in so doing, discover your own path in life?

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/RedDustGames]Patreon[/url]]
